briefing.sprint: Collect all 5 flags and reach the goal before me. If the route gets too hard, follow me.
briefing.flags: Collect 5 flags before the time runs out. Collect them in any order!
briefing.score:
Score target: {target} points.

Build up your SCORE on the way to the goal for a high result.
briefing.challenge.2: Learn to jump off walls, get the flag and return to the goal!
briefing.challenge.3: Now you will learn a new trick: the WALL FLIP. Get the flag and return to the goal!
briefing.challenge.5: Now you will learn to clear small objects with the MONKEY VAULT, the SPIDER JUMP and the MONKEY FLIP. The arrows will help you on the way.
briefing.challenge.6: Time to dance on the pole! Do a few POLE JUMPS, come down with a POLE SLIDE and turn around with a POLE SPIN.
briefing.challenge.score: Score {target} points in {seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}} to pass this challenge.
tutorial.1.0: Learn the basic controls! Use UP, LEFT, RIGHT and DOWN to move. Running is automatic.
tutorial.1.1: Once you are comfortable with the controls, get the flag and come back to me.
tutorial.1.2: There is no time limit, so practise as long as you like.
tutorial.1.done: Cool! Looks like you are ready for the next challenge! Come back if you want more practice.
tutorial.2.0: Now I will teach you to use the terrain to speed up and move more easily. To help you, I have placed arrows along your path. When you reach an arrow, press the matching key to do the right move.
tutorial.2.1: Get the flag once more and come back to me.
tutorial.2.2: If you miss an arrow, don't worry. Just remember the direction and keep your speed up.
tutorial.2.done: Great! Now you can try the other game modes. Remember to use your surroundings to get an edge. That is what extreme running is all about!
tutorial.2.ps: P.S. You can find every move in the Moves menu.
